For this collaborative assignment, we decided to reuse the Gravier dataset, along with the wrangling steps performed in Lab 6, and perform a new analysis and visualization pipeline.

## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| message: false
raw_dir <- "data/_raw/"
data_file <- "gravier.RData"
data_loc <- "https://github.com/ramhiser/datamicroarray/raw/master/data/"

if( !dir.exists(raw_dir) ){
  dir.create(path = raw_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
if( !file.exists(str_c(raw_dir, data_file)) ){
  download.file(
    url = str_c(data_loc, data_file),
    destfile = str_c(raw_dir, data_file))
}
load(file = str_c(raw_dir, data_file))
```

## Data wrangling

### Clean data

```{r}
gravier_clean <- gravier |>
  bind_cols() |>
  as_tibble()
write_csv(gravier_clean, "data/02_gravier_clean.csv.gz")

```

### Augment data

```{r}
gravier_clean_aug <- gravier_clean |>
  mutate(y = case_when(y == "poor" ~ 1,
                       y == "good" ~ 0)) |> 
  relocate(early_metastasis = y)
write_csv(gravier_clean_aug, "data/03_gravier_clean_aug.csv.gz")
```

### Reorganizing the dataset

```{r}
gravier_clean_aug_long <-  gravier_clean_aug |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("g"),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "log2_expr_level",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

gravier_clean_aug_long_nested <- gravier_clean_aug_long |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  nest() |>
  ungroup()

set.seed(10)

reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested <- gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  ungroup() |>
  slice_sample(n = 100)

```

## Modelling: Logistic regression

```{r}
reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested <- reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  mutate(
    model_object = map(
      .x = data,
      .f = ~ glm(early_metastasis ~ log2_expr_level,
                    data = .x,
                    family = "binomial"
                 )
    )
  )

reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested <- reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  mutate(
    model_object_tidy = map(
      .x = model_object,
      .f = ~ tidy(
        .x,
        conf.int = TRUE,
        conf.level = 0.95
      )
    )
  )
```

## Subsequent wrangling

```{r}
gravier_estimates <- reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(gene, model_object_tidy) |>
  unnest(model_object_tidy) |>
  filter(term == "log2_expr_level") |>
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"), #"BH" controls the false discovery rate and is commonly used for gene screening; p_adj_BH makes the calculation explicit.
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    OR_low = exp(conf.low),
    OR_high = exp(conf.high)
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj_BH)

gravier_estimates |>
  select(gene, estimate, odds_ratio, OR_low, OR_high,
         p.value, p_adj_BH) |>
  print(n = 20)
```

## Interpretation

```{r}
gravier_estimates |>
  summarise(
    genes_tested = n(),
    significant_genes = sum(p_adj_BH < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
one_model <- reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  pull(model_object) |>
  pluck(1)

summary(one_model)
one_model$converged
```

Identification and inspection of the 10 "significant" genes that passed the defined threshold:

```{r}
significant_genes <- gravier_estimates |>
  filter(p_adj_BH < 0.05) |>
  arrange(p_adj_BH)

significant_genes |>
  select(
    gene, estimate,
    odds_ratio, OR_low, OR_high,
    p.value, p_adj_BH
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)

```

```{r}
significant_models <- significant_genes |>
  select(gene, p_adj_BH) |>
  left_join(
    reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(gene, model_object),
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj_BH)

# Inspect the gene with the smallest adjusted p-value
significant_models$gene[[1]]
summary(significant_models$model_object[[1]])
```

## Visualization

```{r}
significant_genes <- gravier_estimates |>
  filter(p_adj_BH < 0.05) |>
  mutate(gene = reorder(gene, estimate))

coefficient_plot <- ggplot(
  significant_genes,
  aes(x = estimate, y = gene)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene expression associated with early metastasis",
    subtitle = "10 genes passing BH-adjusted p < 0.05 among 100 tested",
    x = "Log-odds coefficient (95% confidence interval)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Separate logistic models per gene; confidence intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

coefficient_plot
```

Logistic regression graph for g1int380 (the one with the smallest adjusted p-value):

```{r}
gene_to_plot <- "g1int380"

gene_data <- reduced_gravier_clean_aug_long_nested |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(gene == gene_to_plot) |>
  pull(data) |>
  pluck(1)

ggplot(
  gene_data,
  aes(x = log2_expr_level, y = early_metastasis)
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0,
      height = 0.025,
      seed = 10
    ),
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = binomial(link = "logit")),
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "#2166AC",
    fill = "#92C5DE"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Early metastasis and expression of", gene_to_plot),
    x = "Log2 expression level",
    y = "Estimated probability / observed outcome",
    caption = "Points: observed outcomes, slightly jittered. Band: pointwise 95% confidence interval."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
